title: LR-199
author: Let Us All Rejoice
snippet: Let us all rejoice in the Lord, as we celebrate the feast day in honor of all the Saints, at whose festival the Angels rejoice and praise the Son of God.

title: Responsorial Psalm - All Saints
author: Psalm 24: 1bc-2, 3-4ab, 5-6
snippet: Lord, this is the people that longs to see your face.

title: Gospel Acclamation - All Saints
author: Matthew 5:1-12a
snippet: Come to me, all you who labor and are burdened, and I will give you rest, says the Lord.

title: The Feast Meant for Everyone
author: Tom Booth/Sarah Hart
snippet: Bread for the immigrant, bread for the poor, bread for the hungry who beg at our door. Food for the outcast waiting to belong; Come to the feast meant for everyone.

title: Sanctuary
author: John W. Thompson, Randy Scruggs
snippet: Lord, prepare me to be a sanctuary; pure and holy; tried and true. With thanksgiving; I'll be a living Sanctuary for You.

title: Worthy Is the Lamb
author: Ricky Manalo CSP
snippet: Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive honor and glory. Worthy are the ones who believe to receive the goodness of God.

title: Come to Jesus
author: Josh Blakesley
snippet: People of the God of ages Welcome to your brand new day Leave the world and all it's trappings Come into Amazing Grace Let go your every fear There is only mercy here

title: One Heart
author: Curtis Stephan
snippet: You gather nations from east to west and every creature rightly sings your praise. For by the spirit you renew the earth, and give new life to all who cll you name. We celebrate the mighty victory for you rescued us from sin and grave. Blind us all together as one family, bind us all together.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
